title: Storyworks Screens
heading: Storyworks screens

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: six events on two timelines (dated and undated on a path), starter kinds created once, overlap on both rows, touching clears it, unknown order (other timeline, undated) gives no warning, until-before-from refused with a message, date and event positions, Final status, reverse view on the Town, broken value and restore, kinds manager (add, rename, exclusive, type locked in use, delete with reassign and the type warning), Chronicle order, Date unknown, Order unknown and row clicks, reload keeps the states, entry files version 2 with states, manifest version 8, and a version 7 book with a hand-broken entry file that opens and keeps that file untouched. Polish screens checked for raw keys and English.

Fixed on the way: the overlap warning showed the other state's entry id instead of its name; Chronicle rows were squeezed into a narrow column in the detail panel and a relationship row ran its two names together; an old refusal message stayed in the state dialog after the value was fixed; the Polish word for Final differed between the States tab and the Chronicle.
One entry with 200 states, 150 linked events and 150 relationships: States tab about 0.3 s, Chronicle (500 rows) about 0.15 s, saving an edited state under 1 s.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (state-kinds files, entry files version 2, migration on a real folder).

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: new type typed on the fly, reverse label on the other entry's page (Contains, Child, same label when none), duplicate refused with a message, event link and node inspector section, groups, graph (edges, group regions, filters, list view), drag saved to layout.json and kept after reload, Re-layout, relation types manager (rename, reverse label, delete with reassign), entry delete confirm, broken rows, restore, Polish screens.

Fixed on the way: the graph's List button showed a raw key (name clash in the language file); separate clusters flew thousands of units apart; the first drag now saves every position so other nodes do not shift on reopen; relationship rows wrapped one word per line; the type menu stayed open after Enter.
300 entries and 450 relationships: first node about 0.7 s, filter 60 ms, list 80 ms, Re-layout about 0.3 s.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (relation, group and layout files, manifest v7).

sections.title: Checked
items: Codex list, entry editor and types: driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark (starter types; create, rename, change type, aliases, tags, notes, appendix, search by alias, type and tag filters, types dialog, delete with reassign, last type blocked, Trash and restore, keyboard in the list).

Links, Light and Dark: alias "Aldric", Polish alias "Żmija" and non-matches ("Aldrich", "Żmijami") on the Mentions tab; Link in one click gives a plum marker and an Appears in card; Not this one hides it and it stays hidden after reopening; Link all; Link to… picker with remembered tab, keyboard tab switching and alias search; event plus codex link shows both shapes; popover Open and Unlink.

Deleting an entry: broken triangles, popover Missing entry, Problems, This paragraph, POV Missing entry with Clear, node chip Missing entry; Trash restore repairs all. Event chips, rules Used by entries, timeline filter, In this scene, Linked and Links panels. Event links from M4 behave as before (Events tab, Jump, delete and restore an event).

Fixed on the way: the Add a rule box kept the picked title; the sidebar showed "Coming soon"; the entry delete confirm did not count linked passages; the mixed marker label read "1 events and 1 codex entries".

Mention scan on a 500-scene, 300k-word book with 200 entries: about 50 ms plus the 300 ms debounce, so no cache was added. The browser build reads from memory; the real window reads 500 files, so the Tauri check should time it.
Not yet checked: the real Tauri window (entry and type files, image copy, ignored-findings file, manifest v6).

sections.title: Checked
items: Driven through the UI in the browser build, Light and Dark: default categories, create, retitle, change category, tags, description and exceptions saved; search, category and tag filters, no match, Clear filters.

Category dialog: recolour, rename, add, delete with reassign, last category blocked (message shown as text). Rules section in the inspector via the picker with keyboard only, Open chip to the rule and Used in back to the event, Linked card.

Delete a rule: confirm shows the event count, chip turns Missing rule with a Problem card, Trash restore repairs it. Keyboard in the list: Tab, Enter, Space; Escape closes dialogs. Manifest v5 with rule and trash entries. No console errors.
